goal-abs.note: Turns abs into a body fat goal (22.8% → 12-15%) and asks the deadline.
goal-abs.toneNote: Correct but reads like a fact sheet; no encouragement.

goal-wedding.note: Congratulates, uses 14 Feb, safe range, asks target.

goal-unsafe-pace.note: Unsafe pace, ~6 months, offers 62 kg by May.

goal-full-spec.note: Sets 74 kg by 31 Mar, reports replan, first-week focus.

goal-vague-healthier.note: No pressure for a number; sleep, steps, protein.

goal-gain-weight.note: Lean gain, pace, proposes 66 kg by June.

goal-run-10k.note: Gradual build, keeps gym days, asks run days.

goal-switch-to-muscle.note: Recomp explained, asks body fat target.

goal-break-down.note: Pace, daily targets, one focus. No checkpoint along the way (e.g. ~78 kg by mid-Dec), so the 'step by step' is thin.
goal-break-down.toneNote: Accurate but a list of numbers; no encouragement that they're on pace.

goal-toned.note: Strength + protein, body fat goal offered.

goal-tiny-deadline.note: Right facts, but no acknowledgement of the sister's wedding or the pressure they feel.
goal-tiny-deadline.toneNote: Opens with 'isn't safe… water that comes straight back': correct but cold for an emotional ask.

habit-namkeen-night.note: Out of the house, small packs, chana/makhana, no guilt.

habit-gym-bag.note: Bag the night before, straight from office, offers to move the slot.

habit-start-strong-quit.note: Smaller start, bad-day minimum, never miss twice.

habit-forget-logging.note: Photo of the plate, one line is enough.

habit-office-samosa.note: Snack from home at 4:30, samosa sometimes is fine.

habit-midnight-snack.note: Kitchen-closed time, brush teeth, bedtime 15 min earlier.

habit-mom-serves-extra.note: Respectful, extra sabzi/dal, serve own plate.

habit-weekends.note: Weekdays count; one planned meal out, Saturday walk, plan ahead.

habit-morning-walk-snooze.note: Good friction cuts, but no offer to set the walk time or reminder in the routine.

habit-stock-kitchen.note: Short veg list, fried snacks out.

habit-pizza-ruined.note: Reassuring, next meal normal, offers to log.

habit-streak-broken.note: Empathy, last good stretch, never miss twice.

habit-motivation-months.note: Routine over motivation, on-track days, asks their why.

habit-diwali-sweets.note: Give boxes away, out of sight, one planned piece.

habit-water.note: Bottle on the desk, glass with meals, offers to log.
